sentences.text: Sri Arvind Kumar, the learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Arpit Kumar, the learned AGA for the State and perused the record.

2. The present bail application has been filed by the applicant with the prayer to enlarge him on bail in Case Crime No. 257 of 2022, under Sections 34, 420, 467, 468, 471 IPC, Police Station Masauli,
District Barabanki.

3. The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of an FIR lodged on 08.06.2022 against nine named persons, not including the applicant, and an unknown person, alleging that the informant had purchased a plot of land from the co-accused Om Prakash Verma and later on some other persons tried to take possession of the land saying that they had also purchased the same land by a subsequent sale deed executed by Om Prakash Verma.
The FIR does not mention any specific allegation of any act committed by the applicant which may make out commission of any offence by Sangam Verma vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin.Secy. Home Lko.

4.
In the affidavit filed in support of the bail application it has been submitted that the applicant is innocent and he has falsely been implicated in the present case.
The applicant's criminal history of 59 cases has been explained in para 17 of the affidavit filed in support of the bail application.

It has also been submitted that the co-accused Chandan Yadav @ Sonu Yadav and Atul Verma has already been granted bail by means of an order dated 06.12.2022, passed by this Court in Crl. Misc. Bail Application No. 14254 of 2022 and the co-accused Atul Verma has also been enlarged on bail by this court by means of an order dated 07.07.2023, passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.8503 of 2023.
5.

sentences.text: Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that the FIR alleges execution of sale deeds by co-accused Om Prakash Verma; there is no specific allegation of any act committed by the applicant; that two of the co-accused Chandan Yadav @ Sonu Yadav and Atul Verma have already been granted bail by this court and the applicant is languishing in jail since 29.07.2022, I am of the view that the applicant is also entitled to be released on bail on the ground of parity.
6. Accordingly, this bail application is allowed.

Ram.
 
Sangam Verma vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin.Secy. Home Lko.
